newsitem.title: USA: BW/IP says petroleum market shows strength.
newsitem.headline: BW/IP says petroleum market shows strength.

text.p: BW/IP Inc the parent company of BW/IP International Inc said Tuesday that bookings for petroleum transfering equipment reached an all-time company record $145 million in the first half of this year.

The fluid transfer and controls systems maker said in a statement that it had second-quarter bookings of $133 million. But the company warned that not everythying flowed smoothly in the quarter. Input from both the fossil and nuclear power markets remained disappointing, the company said.
BW/IP reported second quarter net income of $9.3 million, or $.38 per share, an increase of 33 percent over second quarter 1996 income of $7.0 million, or $.29 per share.
Earnings estimates compiled by First Call forcast earnings per share of 34 cents for the second quarter.
